coordinates.positive_direction: Increasing q follows the right-hand rule about MJCF axis [-1,0,0]; physical installation sign relative to gravity remains operator-audited.
coordinates.zero_definition: MJCF export q=0 and hardware collection center_position=0 rad; their as-built physical alignment still requires operator confirmation.

measured_or_cad_properties.axis_inertia_definition: a^T I_com a + m * (norm(r)^2 - (a dot r)^2), where r is COM minus joint position
measured_or_cad_properties.inertia_scope: External moving fixture about rs06_joint. Excludes RS06 rotor/output inertia and excludes the MuJoCo joint armature parameter.
measured_or_cad_properties.uncertainty_and_method: Computed from the supplied Fusion inertial tensor, COM, joint axis, and parallel-axis theorem; no independent as-built uncertainty was supplied.
